scripts.build:library: nub run --filter flow-state build && nub run --filter flow-state check:packed-consumers
scripts.check: vp check packages/flow-state-v3 && nub run check:effect && nub run check:plans
scripts.faults: node --experimental-strip-types tools/faults/verdict.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/faults/group.test.ts && bun tools/faults/run.ts
scripts.lint:rules: node --experimental-strip-types tools/lint-bomb/test/rules.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/rules/bans.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/rules/no-mark-probe.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/rules/no-raw-event.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/rules/no-hand-option.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/rules/owners-only.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tools/flow-state-lint/imports.test.ts
scripts.test:stress: node --experimental-strip-types tools/stress/select.test.ts && FLOW_STRESS=1 vp test run packages/flow-state-v3
scripts.verify: nub run check:toolchain && nub run lint:rules && nub run check && nub run test && nub run test:stress && nub run docs:build
